measurements.name: overlap_max
measurements.spice: .meas tran overlap_max MAX v(ov) FROM=1u TO=2.6u

measurements.name: td_ls_off_to_hs_on
measurements.spice: .meas tran td_ls_off_to_hs_on TRIG v(gl) VAL=0.5 FALL=3 TARG v(gh) VAL=4.5 FALL=3

measurements.name: td_hs_off_to_ls_on
measurements.spice: .meas tran td_hs_off_to_ls_on TRIG v(gh) VAL=4.5 RISE=3 TARG v(gl) VAL=0.5 RISE=3

measurements.name: sw_max
measurements.spice: .meas tran sw_max MAX v(sw) FROM=1u TO=2.6u

measurements.name: sw_min
measurements.spice: .meas tran sw_min MIN v(sw) FROM=1u TO=2.6u
